description: Split from fz-kdt.104 by the cold review (2026-08-31): the intern-time canonical clause sort is real, cheap (~8-10% intern cost with a crude string prototype; stored per-Ty key + tie-break would be cheaper), and delivers exactly key confluence -- prototype: LIFO key-set == FIFO key-set on 00183, union(a,b)==union(b,a) types-level red goes green -- but does NOT fix the miscompile (that is fz-kdt.104). REVIEW FINDINGS THAT BIND THE BUILD: (1) comparator basis = canon-label rendering (descr_body/clause_texts machinery, canon.rs:114+); descr_fingerprint (canon.rs:592) is a non-injective grouping key, NOT usable; per-Ty stored key is sound (arena append-only, TypeInterner::intern only pushes); closure lits must render by label not raw FnId (parse-order shifts across versions); free-var-id ties are a documented schedule-dependent residual. (2) Sort must run BEFORE canonicalize_tuple_axis (its mutual-subsumption survivor is arrival-order-picked, mod.rs:289) or the pass must pick survivors by the comparator. (3) The addresser (addressed.rs:276) and convergence collapse (mod.rs:840) clone from interned descrs -- covered, no second change. (4) dedupe_exact_clauses' doc comment (mod.rs:210-222) is superseded -- rewrite same motion; the dedupe itself STAYS (comparator coarser than PartialEq, no safe fold). (5) Intra-clause factor order (Conj.pos/neg, dnf_intersect arrival order) is a second non-canonical dimension the clause sort does not touch. (6) MEASURED FIFO movement to expect: 2 twin-unifications + 1 variant renaming (authorized) + FIVE UNEXPLAINED EXECUTABLE DISAPPEARANCES on 00420 (4x Enum.drop_while#lambda + 1x reduce_while_cont on {list(int), :false|:true}) -- STOP class, must be chased and named before re-pinning 214->207 and the 553->552 work pin. (7) x39/x40 do NOT collapse -- they are content-FORM twins (e.g. two ListSig forms rendering empty_list()), separate normalization question, new ticket if wanted. (8) Packaging-time canon sorts stay (canon normalizes forms intern won't + renders never-interned descrs). Sequence after fz-kdt.104; then re-measure fz-kdt.101 (its residual = the w10/w11 wrapper-index swap).
title: Canonical clause order at Types::intern: same-denotation unions intern to one Ty (key confluence, P2)
